# StudyOS

> StudyOS is a student-first planner for time blocking, focused work, and study execution. It builds incrementally on an inherited open-source planning foundation and runs on web, desktop, and mobile clients.

## Product

- [Home](https://opensunsama.com/): What StudyOS is and how daily planning works in it
- [Download](https://opensunsama.com/download): Desktop apps for macOS, Windows and Linux
- [Open-source task manager](https://opensunsama.com/open-source-task-manager): Why it is open source and how to self-host it

## Features

- [Kanban board](https://opensunsama.com/features/kanban): Plan each day as a column of tasks
- [Time blocking](https://opensunsama.com/features/time-blocking): Drag tasks onto a calendar timeline
- [Focus mode](https://opensunsama.com/features/focus-mode): Work on one task with a timer
- [AI integration](https://opensunsama.com/features/ai-integration): Control your planner from any AI agent over MCP
- [Command palette](https://opensunsama.com/features/command-palette): Keyboard-first navigation with Cmd+K
- [Calendar sync](https://opensunsama.com/features/calendar-sync): Two-way sync with Google Calendar, Outlook and iCloud

## Docs

- [Getting started](https://opensunsama.com/docs/getting-started): Set up your account and plan your first day
- [MCP overview](https://opensunsama.com/docs/mcp/overview): Connect Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and other agents with one URL and OAuth
- [Connect Claude](https://opensunsama.com/docs/mcp/claude): Add StudyOS as a Claude connector
- [Connect ChatGPT](https://opensunsama.com/docs/mcp/chatgpt): Add StudyOS to ChatGPT
- [REST API: tasks](https://opensunsama.com/docs/api/tasks): Create and update tasks from code
- [Self-hosting with Docker](https://opensunsama.com/docs/self-hosting/docker): Run your own instance
